description: What one document links to and from, strongest first. Each link says how it is known: declared (a person made it), extracted (the file says so), or inferred (a reading that could be wrong), with a confidence and the file and line it came from. A reference that could mean several documents is listed as ambiguous with its candidates, and is never drawn as a link. doc_id is the id get_docs returns. Read-only.

doc_id.description: A document id, as get_docs returns it

name: get_document_links
